Q5786.reason: Post-injury refusal is avoidable consequences, not contributory negligence, so the estate recovers only the original wound and pain up to the transfusion refusal.

Q5253.reason: The burglary fragment does not support reversions; executory interests are the future interest the Rule Against Perpetuities principally restricts.

Q5347.reason: Preformed muscle ATP is the initial fuel and only covers about 1–2 seconds of maximal force before phosphocreatine replenishes it.
